display_name: Income Tax Act 2007 (UK), from the individual taxpayer's seat, under one top-level goal — personal allowance, income tax liability on wages, savings and dividends, and the marriage allowance — and those three goals

others: I may elect to transfer my allowance (ita-rules.l4)

scope: Goal-focused, at the user's direction, for a UK resident individual who is not a Scottish or Welsh taxpayer and has no property income: ss 8, 10(2)-(3A), (5)-(6), 12-13A, 16, 23 Steps 3-6, 25(2)-(3A), 35, 55B(1)-(6), 55C(1), 58, 414(2) and 415 of the revised text as at 16 September 2026. The rates set by Parliament are inputs. Left out on purpose: devolved and non-resident rates, property income, trusts, Step 2 reliefs, other allowances and reductions, Step 7 charges.

not_reviewed.note: No domain expert has read this against the Act. An independent test pass has been run (see INDEPENDENT-TEST-REPORT.md). The pipeline has not been run.
